levels.text: Shorter field, cheaper, cast on the move

name: Mercenary Consecrated Ground
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Consecrated Ground (players/priest/mercenary/consecrated_ground_merc.sval, 17 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): duration 5 s (6.5 s); not blocking. Its own mana 75 (90), cooldown 0.5 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Consecrated Ground lasts 5 s (40 magical per second, 25% returned as healing), costs less, and doesn't stop you while you cast it.
